instruction: Compare categories by a quantitative metric using a clear aggregate chart.
description: Use this pattern when the user asks to compare groups, methods, models, stages, or categories by a numeric measure. Prefer aggregated bar/point charts with explicit axis titles that mention the source column and aggregation.

instruction: Compare multiple metrics that have different numeric scales.
description: Use this pattern when multiple measures such as time, tokens, score, or error are plotted together. Prefer facet/repeat/layer with independent y-scales instead of forcing unrelated metrics onto one shared scale.

instruction: Show the distribution of a numeric column.
description: Use a histogram pattern when the user asks about distribution, spread, frequency, or counts over ranges of a quantitative variable.
